raw_response:
I am 68 years old, and I have farmed these 5 mu in Quzhou County for 40 years. I finished middle school, so I can read fertilizer labels and I sometimes go to the village training when they hand out seed catalogs. But I trust my own field and my neighbor Lao Zhang’s field more than any paper. Last year my cabbage fetched a good price, and Lao Zhang’s hybrid cabbage did even better, so I will keep my cabbage–long bean–spinach rotation on 3 mu this year. On the other 2 mu I will put 1 mu of chili in spring and 1 mu of maize in summer. Two old people cannot handle more than that.

For the 3 mu of spring cabbage, I will rotary till first. I buy one and a half bags of 15-15-15 compound fertilizer per mu — that is 75 jin — and spread it as base fertilizer. Then I topdress with half a bag of urea, 25 jin per mu. I will irrigate 6 times from the well and spray pesticide 4 times because the cabbage worms were bad two years ago. I expect about 5000 jin per mu if the weather is normal.

After I pull the cabbage out in early summer, I plant kidney beans on the same 3 mu. Beans fix their own nitrogen, so I only put one bag of compound fertilizer per mu, 50 jin. I irrigate 4 times and spray 3 times for aphids. I hope for 1200 jin per mu.

When the beans finish in autumn, I plant spinach. I put one bag of compound and half a bag of urea per mu, water 3 times, and spray once for leaf spot. Should get around 2000 jin per mu.

My 1 mu of chili I transplant in spring. I give it one and a half bags of compound and half a bag of urea per mu, water 5 times, and spray 4 times for mites and virus. I want 2000 jin of fresh chili.

The 1 mu of maize I plant in summer for my own chickens. I use one bag of compound and about 15 jin of urea per mu, water twice, and spray twice. I expect 600 jin per mu.

I figure the fertilizer and pesticide for the vegetables cost me about 800 yuan per mu. For maize it is about 400 yuan. I would rather spend a little more on fertilizer than risk a bad harvest. A failed crop means no money for my grandson’s school fees. Wasting some fertilizer is just a few hundred yuan. I watch what the input dealer says, but if Lao Zhang buys a certain seed and his plants look strong, I buy the same one.
